newsitem.title: UK: EBRD ups 20-year zero coupon bond to 2.5 bln rand.
newsitem.headline: EBRD ups 20-year zero coupon bond to 2.5 bln rand.

text.p: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development has increased to 2.5 billion rand from 2.0 billion rand the size of its 20-year zero coupon bond, lead manager Toronto Dominion said on Monday.
All other terms and conditions remained the same.
The deal was launched earlier along with a five billion rand 30-year zero coupon bond.
The 20-year notes were reoffered at 6.85 percent of face value, the 30-year notes at 2.20 percent.
